e.title: BMA（百慕大金融管理局）：保险发牌、保险沙盒与创新中心、企业服务提供者发牌
e.title_en: BMA (Bermuda Monetary Authority): insurance licensing, an insurance sandbox and innovation hub, and corporate service provider licensing
e.title_hk: BMA（百慕大金融管理局）：保險發牌、保險沙盒與創新中心、企業服務提供者發牌
e.summary: 百慕大金融管理局：设保险发牌要求与「如何设立专属/商业保险公司」指引、保险监管与集团监管、保险沙盒与保险创新中心，并对企业服务提供者（CSP）单独发牌；文件中心按立法、公告、征求意见稿、政策指引、报送表与统计等类型分层
e.summary_en: The Bermuda Monetary Authority: it provides insurance licensing requirements and a guide to setting up a captive or commercial insurer, insurance and group supervision, an insurance sandbox and insurance innovation hub, and separate licensing for corporate service providers (CSPs); its documents centre is layered by type, including legislation, bulletins, consultation papers, policy and guidance, reporting forms and statistics
e.summary_hk: 百慕大金融管理局：設保險發牌要求與「如何設立專屬／商業保險公司」指引、保險監管與集團監管、保險沙盒與保險創新中心，並對企業服務提供者（CSP）單獨發牌；文件中心按立法、公告、徵求意見稿、政策指引、報送表與統計等類型分層
e.body:
**BMA（Bermuda Monetary Authority，百慕大金融管理局）** 是**百慕大的金融监管机构**（站点标题实测 **「Regulatory, Monetary, and Financial Advisory Body of Bermuda - BMA」**）。本条目补的是**「离岸保险辖区的监管者」这一形态**——**同轮 [[siia]] 与 [[cica]] 是行业侧、[[vermont-captive]] 是在岸辖区政府，而 BMA 补的是**离岸辖区的监管者视角****。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：**站点首页 145.7KB，标题「Regulatory, Monetary, and Financial Advisory Body of Bermuda - BMA」**；⭐⭐ **「Bermuda Insurance Innovation（保险沙盒与保险创新中心）」页 `/innovative-insurance-sandbox` 实测 144.0KB，标题「Bermuda Insurance Innovation | BMA Sandbox and Insurance Innovation Hub | InsurTech」**；⭐⭐ **「Corporate Service Provider Licensing in Bermuda（企业服务提供者发牌）」页 `/csp-licensing` 实测 130.9KB**；⭐ **「How to Set Up a Captive/Commercial Insurer（如何设立专属/商业保险公司）」页 `/insurance-licensing-how-to-set-up-an-insurance-company` 实测 131.1KB**；⭐ **「Insurance（保险文件中心）」页 `/documents-centre/statstics/documents-insurance` 实测 235.8KB**（**注意：该路径中「statstics」为站点自身的拼写，词条内照实引用**）。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的结构**：**保险侧** 含 **`/insurance-licensing-requirements`**、**`/insurance-licensing-how-to-set-up-an-insurance-company`**、**`/insurance-supervision-regulation`**、⭐ **`/insurance-group-supervision`（集团监管）**、⭐ **`/insurance-innovation`**、⭐ **`/innovative-insurance-sandbox`**；⭐ **企业服务提供者（CSP）侧单独设 `csp-licensing` 与 `csp-supervision-regulation`**；**其他受监管业务**实测含银行、投资业务、投资基金、信托、信用合作社、货币服务、数字资产等各自的发牌与监管栏目；⭐ **文件中心按类型分层实测**：**`documents-legislation`（立法）**、**`bulletins`（公告）**、**`discussion-consultation-papers`（讨论与征求意见稿）**、**`documents-policy-and-guidance`（政策与指引）**、**`documents-reporting-forms-and-guidelines`（报送表与指引）**、⭐ **`statstics`（统计）**、以及 **`publications/annual-reports`（年报）** 与 **`publications/business-plan`（业务计划）**；另有 **`/regulated-entities`**、**`/standards-regulations`** 与 **`/about-us`**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 「离岸辖区的监管者如何主动招揽」是本轮的核心对照之一**——**BMA 不只做监管，还提供「如何设立专属/商业保险公司」的操作指引、**保险沙盒与创新中心**、以及**企业服务提供者发牌**；**这三件事合起来构成一个辖区的**供给侧制度组合****：**降低设立摩擦（指引）+ 允许试错（沙盒）+ 规范中介服务者（发牌）**；**与同轮 [[vermont-captive]] 的「Why Vermont（含事实与数据）+ 设立与运营（含费用）」形成**离岸 vs 在岸两种招揽方式**的对照**（**注意：本次未打开任何一页内容，故不转述其要求、流程或费用**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「保险沙盒」补上一个此前缺失的形态**——**池内「监管沙盒」实测仅 3 条，且全部是 AI 或黑客松性质**（[[hk-genai-sandbox-axa-manulife]]、[[ginsim]]、[[thinkingbox]]），**而 BMA 的沙盒是**保险产品与保险科技创新**的监管沙盒**；**对做保险创新与监管试验的学生，这是一个制度形态不同的样本**（**且其页面标题实测含「InsurTech」**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「企业服务提供者（CSP）单独发牌」与池内的 TPA 形态构成一组有价值的对照**——**同轮 [[siia]] 代表美国的 TPA（第三方管理人）**，**而 BMA 对 CSP（企业服务提供者，在专属保险语境下即管理人/服务公司）单独发牌并单独监管**；**即「保险业里的第三方服务者」在两个辖区被分别组织与监管**——**这是池内此前没有的一层**（**本次未打开 CSP 页面，故不转述发牌条件、资本要求或监管范围**）。**④ ⭐ 「集团监管（insurance group supervision）」栏目值得注意**——**专属保险常以集团形式组建**，**故集团层监管是其制度的一部分**（**本次未打开**）。**⑤ ⭐ 文件中心按**文件类型**而非按业务线分层，是一种清晰的监管披露结构**——**立法 / 公告 / 讨论与征求意见稿 / 政策与指引 / 报送表与指引 / 统计 / 年报 / 业务计划**；**对需要查找某类监管文件的读者，这种结构比按业务线混杂更可用**；**可与池内 [[eiopa-registers]] 的 DPM/XBRL 报送、[[assal]] 的「国际标准/自有标准/成员国法规」三层并读——三者都是**监管文件的组织方式**，但结构不同**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与四个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、以及导航与链接逐字实测的保险、CSP、文件中心与出版物结构**，**但未打开任何内容页正文、未打开沙盒与创新中心内容、CSP 发牌要求、设立指引、集团监管页、任何监管文件或年报**，因此**不能转述任何发牌条件、资本要求、沙盒准入标准、设立流程、监管文件内容或统计数值**；**② ⭐ 「保险沙盒与创新中心」为**页面标题逐字实测**（**标题含「Sandbox and Insurance Innovation Hub | InsurTech」**），**但其准入条件、参与机构与运作方式本次未核实**；**③ ⭐ 「CSP 即专属保险管理人/服务公司」这一对应关系为**依据专属保险行业通行术语的推断**——**本次未打开任何一页定义 CSP 的业务范围**，**词条内因此以「企业服务提供者」直译并标注该推断**；**④ 路径中的「statstics」为**站点自身拼写**，**本词条照实引用以保持可核对**；**⑤ 「百慕大为全球主要专属保险辖区之一」这类规模判断**本次未核实，**故词条内不主张其市场排名或份额**；**⑥ BMA 的法定地位、成立年份与治理结构本次未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** BMA 提供精算工具、定价模型或可批量下载的数据集**。**核实说明**：首页（145.7KB）、`/innovative-insurance-sandbox`（144.0KB）、`/csp-licensing`（130.9KB）、`/insurance-licensing-how-to-set-up-an-insurance-company`（131.1KB）、`/documents-centre/statstics/documents-insurance`（235.8KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与导航；**未打开任何内容正文、监管文件或年报**。
e.body_en:
**BMA (the Bermuda Monetary Authority)** is **Bermuda’s financial regulator** (measured site title **"Regulatory, Monetary, and Financial Advisory Body of Bermuda - BMA"**). This entry adds the **"regulator of an offshore insurance domicile"** form — **[[siia]] and [[cica]] are the industry side and [[vermont-captive]] an onshore domicile government in the same round, while BMA supplies the offshore regulator’s perspective**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the **homepage is 145.7KB with the measured title "Regulatory, Monetary, and Financial Advisory Body of Bermuda - BMA"**; ⭐⭐ the **"Bermuda Insurance Innovation" page `/innovative-insurance-sandbox` measures 144.0KB with the measured title "Bermuda Insurance Innovation | BMA Sandbox and Insurance Innovation Hub | InsurTech"**; ⭐⭐ the **"Corporate Service Provider Licensing in Bermuda" page measures 130.9KB**; ⭐ the **"How to Set Up a Captive/Commercial Insurer" page measures 131.1KB**; ⭐ the **"Insurance" documents-centre page measures 235.8KB** (**note: "statstics" in that path is the site’s own spelling, quoted verbatim so the reference stays checkable**). **Structure read verbatim from navigation and links**: on the **insurance** side — **`/insurance-licensing-requirements`**, **`/insurance-licensing-how-to-set-up-an-insurance-company`**, **`/insurance-supervision-regulation`**, ⭐ **`/insurance-group-supervision`**, ⭐ **`/insurance-innovation`** and ⭐ **`/innovative-insurance-sandbox`**; ⭐ **corporate service providers (CSPs) have separate `csp-licensing` and `csp-supervision-regulation` sections**; **other regulated sectors** measurably include banking, investment business, investment funds, trusts, credit unions, money service business and digital assets, each with licensing and supervision sections; ⭐ **the documents centre is layered by document type**: **legislation**, **bulletins**, **discussion and consultation papers**, **policy and guidance**, **reporting forms and guidelines**, ⭐ **statistics**, plus **annual reports** and a **business plan**; there are also **`/regulated-entities`**, **`/standards-regulations`** and **`/about-us`**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐ How an offshore domicile regulator actively solicits business is one of the round’s core contrasts** — **BMA not only supervises but also provides an operational guide to setting up a captive or commercial insurer, runs an insurance sandbox and innovation hub, and licenses corporate service providers**; **together these three form a domicile’s supply-side institutional package**: **lowering setup friction (guidance) + allowing experimentation (sandbox) + regulating intermediary service providers (licensing)**; **this contrasts with [[vermont-captive]]’s "Why Vermont (with facts and figures) + forming and operating (with fees)" as offshore versus onshore solicitation styles** (**note: no page content was opened, so no requirement, process or fee is restated**). **② ⭐⭐ The insurance sandbox fills a previously missing form** — **the corpus’s "regulatory sandbox" entries measured only three, all AI or hackathon in nature** ([[hk-genai-sandbox-axa-manulife]], [[ginsim]], [[thinkingbox]]), **whereas BMA’s is a sandbox for insurance products and insurance technology innovation**; **a sample of a different institutional form for students of insurance innovation and regulatory experimentation** (**and its page title measurably includes "InsurTech"**). **③ ⭐⭐ Separate licensing of corporate service providers (CSPs) forms a valuable contrast with the corpus’s TPA form** — **[[siia]] in the same round represents US TPAs (third-party administrators)**, **while BMA licenses and supervises CSPs (corporate service providers, in the captive context the managers and service companies) separately**; **i.e. "third-party service providers in insurance" are organised and regulated differently in two jurisdictions** — **a layer the corpus lacked** (**the CSP page was not opened, so no licensing condition, capital requirement or supervisory scope is restated**). **④ ⭐ An "insurance group supervision" section is notable** — **captives are often organised in groups**, **so group-level supervision is part of the regime** (**not opened**). **⑤ ⭐ The documents centre is layered by document type rather than by business line, a clear supervisory disclosure structure** — **legislation / bulletins / discussion and consultation papers / policy and guidance / reporting forms and guidelines / statistics / annual reports / business plan**; **for readers looking for a class of supervisory document this is more usable than a mix by business line**; **readable with the DPM/XBRL reporting of [[eiopa-registers]] and [[assal]]’s three layers of international standards, own standards and member-country regulation — all three organise supervisory documents, but differently**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and four pages’ existence, titles and sizes, and the insurance, CSP, documents-centre and publication structures read verbatim from navigation and links**, **but opened no content page body, no sandbox or innovation hub content, no CSP licensing requirement, no setup guide, no group supervision page, no supervisory document and no annual report**, so **no licensing condition, capital requirement, sandbox admission criterion, setup process, supervisory document content or statistic can be restated**; **② ⭐ "insurance sandbox and innovation hub" is read verbatim from the page title** (**which contains "Sandbox and Insurance Innovation Hub | InsurTech"**), **but its admission criteria, participating institutions and operation were not verified**; **③ ⭐ The equivalence "CSP means captive manager or service company" is an inference from standard captive-industry terminology** — **no page defining the CSP business scope was opened**, **so the entry gives the literal rendering "corporate service provider" and flags the inference**; **④ "statstics" in the path is the site’s own spelling**, **quoted verbatim to keep the reference checkable**; **⑤ Claims about Bermuda’s scale as a captive domicile** were not verified, **so the entry asserts no market ranking or share**; **⑥ BMA’s legal status, founding year and governance were not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim BMA provides actuarial tools, pricing models or a bulk-downloadable dataset**. **Verification note**: the homepage (145.7KB), `/innovative-insurance-sandbox` (144.0KB), `/csp-licensing` (130.9KB), `/insurance-licensing-how-to-set-up-an-insurance-company` (131.1KB) and `/documents-centre/statstics/documents-insurance` (235.8KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; **no content body, supervisory document or annual report was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**BMA（Bermuda Monetary Authority，百慕大金融管理局）** 是**百慕大的金融監管機構**（站點標題實測 **「Regulatory, Monetary, and Financial Advisory Body of Bermuda - BMA」**）。本條目補的是**「離岸保險轄區的監管者」這一形態**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **145.7KB**；⭐⭐ **「Bermuda Insurance Innovation」頁 144.0KB，標題「Bermuda Insurance Innovation | BMA Sandbox and Insurance Innovation Hub | InsurTech」**；⭐⭐ **「Corporate Service Provider Licensing in Bermuda」頁 130.9KB**；⭐ **「How to Set Up a Captive/Commercial Insurer」頁 131.1KB**；⭐ **「Insurance」文件中心頁 235.8KB**（**路徑中的「statstics」為站點自身拼寫，照實引用**）。**導航與連結逐字實測**：保險側含 **insurance-licensing-requirements／insurance-licensing-how-to-set-up-an-insurance-company／insurance-supervision-regulation／⭐insurance-group-supervision／⭐insurance-innovation／⭐innovative-insurance-sandbox**；⭐ **企業服務提供者（CSP）單獨設 `csp-licensing` 與 `csp-supervision-regulation`**；⭐ **文件中心按類型分層**：**legislation／bulletins／discussion-consultation-papers／documents-policy-and-guidance／documents-reporting-forms-and-guidelines／⭐statstics／publications-annual-reports／publications-business-plan**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 「離岸轄區如何主動招攬」是本輪核心對照之一**——**降低設立摩擦（指引）+ 允許試錯（沙盒）+ 規範中介服務者（CSP 發牌）三件事合起來構成一個轄區的**供給側制度組合****；**與同輪 [[vermont-captive]] 形成**離岸 vs 在岸**招攬方式對照**（**未打開任何一頁內容，故不轉述要求、流程或費用**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「保險沙盒」補上一個此前缺失的形態**——**池內「監管沙盒」僅 3 條且全為 AI 或黑客松性質，而 BMA 的沙盒是**保險產品與保險科技創新**的監管沙盒**。**③ ⭐⭐ 「CSP 單獨發牌」與池內 TPA 形態構成有價值的對照**——**同輪 [[siia]] 代表美國 TPA，而 BMA 對 CSP 單獨發牌並監管**；**即「保險業裡的第三方服務者」在兩個轄區被分別組織與監管**。**④ ⭐ 「集團監管」欄目值得注意**（**未打開**）。**⑤ ⭐ 文件中心按文件類型分層，是一種清晰的監管披露結構**（可與 [[eiopa-registers]]、[[assal]] 並讀）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與四個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航與連結逐字實測的結構**，**但未打開任何內容正文、沙盒與創新中心內容、CSP 發牌要求、設立指引、集團監管頁、任何監管文件或年報**，故**不能轉述任何發牌條件、資本要求、沙盒准入標準、設立流程、監管文件內容或統計數值**；**② ⭐ 「保險沙盒與創新中心」為頁面標題逐字實測**，**但其准入條件、參與機構與運作方式未核實**；**③ ⭐ 「CSP 即專屬保險管理人／服務公司」為**依據行業通行術語的推斷****——**未打開任何一頁定義 CSP 業務範圍**，**詞條內以「企業服務提供者」直譯並標註該推斷**；**④「statstics」為站點自身拼寫，照實引用**；**⑤ 「百慕大為全球主要專屬保險轄區之一」這類規模判斷未核實，故不主張其市場排名或份額**；**⑥ 法定地位、成立年份與治理結構未核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** BMA 提供精算工具、定價模型或可批量下載的數據集**。**核實說明**：五個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題與導航；**未打開任何內容正文、監管文件或年報**。
